hooks.command: if [ -z "$MTH_GUARD_ROOT" ]; then echo "write guard: MTH_GUARD_ROOT is not set (run agents through tools/agents/run-agent.sh)" >&2; exit 2; fi; g="$MTH_GUARD_ROOT/tools/agents/guard-write.mjs"; if [ -f "$g" ]; then node "$g" frontend-ux-engineer; rc=$?; else echo "write guard missing" >&2; rc=2; fi; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit 2
